name: DICER1 Tumor-Predisposition Syndrome

criteria.description: Presence of a pathogenic germline DICER1 gene mutation
Diagnosis of pleuropulmonary blastoma (PPB) at any age
Presence of multinodular goiter, especially in childhood or adolescence
Presence of other DICER1-associated tumors such as cystic nephroma, ovarian Sertoli-Leydig cell tumor, or pituitary blastoma

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Pathogenic germline DICER1 mutation plus at least one major or two minor criteria
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is essential for confirmation; clinical features vary widely.

pathognomonic.notes: Rare pediatric lung tumor strongly associated with DICER1 mutations
Sex cord-stromal tumor linked to DICER1 syndrome
searchTerms: ovarian tumor with male cell types

common.notes: Common thyroid manifestation in children and adolescents
Benign renal tumor often presenting in early childhood
Rare embryonal tumor of the pituitary gland
Benign nasal tumor associated with DICER1 mutations

occasional.notes: Rare soft tissue tumor linked to DICER1 syndrome
Malignant thyroid tumor occurring less frequently
Pediatric kidney cancer occasionally seen in DICER1 mutation carriers
Rare intraocular tumor associated with DICER1 syndrome

rare.symptomName: Pleuropulmonary blastoma type I cystic lesions
Embryonal tumor of the central nervous system
rare.notes: Rare CNS tumors linked to DICER1 mutations
Rare soft tissue tumor in the mediastinum

laboratory: Detection of pathogenic germline DICER1 mutations via genetic testing
Elevated thyroid function tests in multinodular goiter cases
imaging: Chest CT showing cystic or solid lung lesions consistent with pleuropulmonary blastoma
Ultrasound or MRI revealing multinodular goiter or cystic nephroma
MRI or CT identifying pituitary or CNS tumors
other: Histopathological confirmation of associated tumors (e.g., Sertoli-Leydig cell tumor, cystic nephroma)

distinguishingFeatures: Broader tumor spectrum including sarcomas and breast cancer
Medullary thyroid carcinoma and pheochromocytoma predominance

redFlags: Early onset pleuropulmonary blastoma or cystic lung lesions
Presence of multiple rare tumors linked to DICER1 mutations
references: Schultz et al., DICER1 Syndrome: A Review of the Clinical and Molecular Features, Genetics in Medicine, 2018
Foulkes et al., DICER1 Tumor Predisposition Syndrome, GeneReviews, 2020
Orphanet Report on DICER1 Tumor-Predisposition Syndrome, Orphanet, 2023
